definitions.explanation: The person who plans and leads a criminal act, conspiracy, or organized wrongdoing. The one behind the scheme.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}の{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}が{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: The mastermind of the incident was arrested.

examples.japanese: {首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}はまだ{特定|とくてい}されていない。
examples.english: The ringleader has not yet been identified.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}は{詐欺|さぎ}グループの{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}を{追|お}っている。
examples.english: The police are pursuing the mastermind of the fraud ring.

notes: Composed of {首謀|しゅぼう} (plotting, scheming) + {者|しゃ} (person). Almost always carries a negative connotation — the person behind illegal or harmful activities. Common collocations: {首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}を{逮捕|たいほ}する (to arrest the ringleader), {首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}を{特定|とくてい}する (to identify the mastermind). Compare with {黒幕|くろまく} (puppet master — someone pulling strings from behind the scenes) and {主犯|しゅはん} (principal offender — the legal term).
